metadata.description: Portfolio of Edoardo Vincenzi, Senior Software Engineer specialized in frontend with full stack experience. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS. Over 9 years of experience.

hero.subtitle: Hi, I'm Edoardo
hero.title:
Senior

Software Engineer.
hero.tagline: Frontend and full stack with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js. Over 9 years of experience building web and enterprise applications, from requirements analysis to release, from real-time architectures to production AI integrations.
hero.availability: Open to new opportunities · Full-time, remote or hybrid

about.p1: I am a Software Engineer with 9 years of experience delivering web and enterprise applications across the whole software lifecycle: from requirements analysis and solution design to development, testing and release. Frontend is my core strength, with React, Next.js and TypeScript, but I'm just as comfortable on the backend, integrating Node.js/NestJS services, REST APIs, PostgreSQL and C#/.NET legacy systems.
about.p2: Driven by curiosity and a strong product mindset, I continuously refine my skills and embrace new technologies, from real-time architectures to AI-powered pipelines. Throughout my career I've collaborated with companies of different sizes, from startups to enterprise organizations, working on component architecture and state management as well as APIs, databases and design systems.
about.p3: Great software is the result of solid engineering practices combined with a deep focus on user experience and long-term maintainability. I enjoy working closely with clients and cross-functional teams, modernizing existing applications and taking ownership of projects end to end. I'm now looking for a team where I can bring this experience and keep growing.

items.description: Delivered web and enterprise applications for companies of different sizes, owning projects end to end: from requirements analysis and architecture to frontend and backend development and release. Selected projects:

projects.name: Battlepip
projects.detail: Real-time trading app (PWA) with Server-Sent Events and TradingView charts. Integrated the frontend with an AWS EC2 backend and resolved production connectivity issues, within a two-person team.

projects.name: Geeks Creation
projects.detail: AI-assisted workflow to extract structured data from images and populate a CRM, with multi-step service integrations (Vercel AI SDK) and an evaluation layer to monitor extraction accuracy.

projects.name: Toduba
projects.detail: Refactored a Next.js/React platform for maintainability and scalability, improving data-handling patterns and introducing unit (Vitest, React Testing Library) and E2E (Playwright) tests.

projects.name: Red Software
projects.detail: Management platform built from scratch (Next.js, TypeScript) with complex workflows, roles and permissions. Integrated backend REST services and collaborated on NestJS APIs.

projects.name: MeApp
projects.detail: Led development of two internal back-office applications and a React Native mobile app for a recycling startup, from product flows and architecture to delivery.

projects.name: Mom
projects.detail: From client requirements to functional flows and UX in Figma, through to an accessible (WCAG) investment portal with user management, subscriptions and financial simulations (Next.js, TypeScript).

projects.name: Crm Dematech Impianti
projects.detail: Led development of a CRM for construction sites, project tracking, client relationships and billing: frontend in React, TypeScript, React Query and ShadCN UI, backend in Node.js.

items.description: Developed enterprise web applications in React and TypeScript, translating business requirements into product features. Designed the UX in Figma, implemented a micro frontend architecture with Module Federation and built unit and E2E test suites.

Developed legal management software from scratch using Vue.js and TypeScript, with a Node.js backend. Designed functional flows and interfaces with Figma and Penpot, and added unit and E2E test coverage.

Developed and maintained enterprise applications using React, TypeScript and shared UI components. Established coding guidelines for internal and external collaborators and standardized a Material UI design system to accelerate delivery.
Developed CRM features using JavaScript, jQuery and C#/.NET Framework 4.8, working with PostgreSQL databases.
Developed C# WPF desktop applications and integrated legacy-source data (XML, CSV, flat files, EDIFACT) with data warehouse tables using ETL mapping tools.

formal.description: Intensive React specialization course for building modern frontend applications.
Advanced training program in front-end development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, modern frameworks, and best practices.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. Achieved a GPA of 3.7 on the American GPA scale (on a scale of 4.0), equivalent to 92 points.

Advanced type system, generics, application architecture.
